segments.reference: tuvo ana ocasión de buscar un parecido y si en las facciones no pudo hallarlo lo encontró en la voz así como en el modo de sentir y de expresarse
segments.hypothesis: Anna had occasion to look for a resemblance, and if in the factions she could not find it, she found it in the voice, as well as in the way of feeling and expressing herself.

segments.reference: JUST THEN LEOCADIA CAME TO HERSELF AND EMBRACING THE CROSS SEEMED CHANGED INTO A SEA OF TEARS AND THE GENTLEMAN REMAINED IN UTTER BEWILDERMENT UNTIL HIS WIFE HAD REPEATED TO HIM FROM BEGINNING TO END LEOCADIA'S WHOLE STORY AND HE BELIEVED IT THROUGH THE BLESSED DISPENSATION OF HEAVEN WHICH HAD CONFIRMED IT BY SO MANY CONVINCING TESTIMONIES
segments.hypothesis: just then leocadia came to herself and embracing the cross seemed changed into a sea of tears and the gentleman remaining in utter bewilderment until his wife had repeated to him from beginning to end leocadia's whole story and he believed it through the blessed dispensation of heaven which had confirmed it by so many convincing testimonies
